summary: Frontend-only regression per review request. Verified trust bar strings + TripAdvisor owl image, desktop Expert advice popover (hover + click), footer certification transparent PNGs, brand blue boxed stars, mobile drawer (320px right-aligned, overlay, body scroll lock, 9 root items + 2 dividers), Destinations level with region thumbnails and Africa accordion listing Egypt, Egypt -> /afrika/aegypten, Asia first sub item 'Asia' -> /asien, back button, Expert advice inside drawer, close via X/overlay/Escape, banner dismissal persistence within session, and regression render of /afrika/aegypten and /asien. Zero console errors across desktop and mobile.

integration_issues.issue: On hover-capable pointer, moving mouse onto the button first fires the container's mouseenter (opens popover), so the following mousedown of the same tap always sees state=true and toggles it back to false. Result: a mouse-user cannot 'click to open' from a cold state (hover already opened it), and a click after hover unexpectedly closes it. It still meets spec (opens on hover; closes on outside click), but true click-toggle only works on touch/no-hover pointers. Consider guarding onClick when hovered, or moving hover handlers to media (hover:hover) only.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix desktop nav-phone click-toggle on hover-capable devices so clicking with mouse doesn't immediately close the just-hover-opened popover.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileDrawer overlay is beneath drawer (z-99 vs z-100). Playwright test click on element center is intercepted by drawer. Real user click on the visible left strip works. Not a bug, just a testability note.
ExpertAdvicePanel isPhoneOpen() uses IST-based schedule and status may show 'Outside opening hours.' for the second block — acceptable per spec.

Header nav-phone: hoverIn fires simultaneously with click on mouse pointer devices causing toggle-close; consider conditional hover binding via matchMedia('(hover:hover)') or ignoring click when hover just opened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec items pass. TripAdvisor owl img nw=271, cert images loaded (nw>0). Brand stars filled rgb(23,67,88). Drawer box x=70 width=320 on 390 viewport. Africa accordion contains Egypt->/afrika/aegypten; Asia first item Asia->/asien. Banner dismissal persists via sessionStorage. Only minor observation is desktop click-toggle behavior on hover-capable pointers (see integration_issues).
